name: comet-profile-switcher
title: Comet Profile Switcher
description: Open any Comet browser profile from Raycast. Assign profiles to commands and give each its own alias or hotkey.
author: alexa

commands.name: switch-profile
commands.title: Switch Comet Profile
commands.subtitle: Comet
commands.description: Browse your Comet profiles and open one. Focuses the profile's window if it is already open.

commands.name: slot-1
commands.title: Profile 1
commands.subtitle: Comet
commands.description: Opens the Comet profile you assign to this command. Give it an alias or hotkey so that profile is one keystroke away.

preferences.name: profile
preferences.title: Comet Profile
preferences.description: The profile this command opens: its name as shown in Comet's profile menu (e.g. Work), or its folder name (e.g. Profile 2).

preferences.label: Always open a new window
preferences.description: By default Comet focuses an existing window for the profile if one is open. Enable this to open a fresh window every time.
